body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cozumel, Mexico. It starts at Avenida Constituyentes.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Learn about the rich history of chocolate through seven interactive rooms, each one lit up with engaging sound and light displays offered in six different languages.
>
> The grand finale? You'll end your journey in a demonstration room, where a tantalizing chocolate tasting awaits.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €17.26. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
